methods.explanation:
The standalone stem does not identify the property theorem. For example, the tangent property theorem concludes that a tangent is perpendicular to the line containing the radius to the point of tangency, which would give A.

If the reported heading, “Properties of Lines Perpendicular to Planes,” identifies the intended theorem, the two lines are distinct and perpendicular to the same plane. Both lines being perpendicular to the same plane implies that they are parallel. Thus the answer is B, Parallel, under that interpretation; the standalone stem alone does not determine a unique choice.
